deposits.genre_observed: heteronym compendium of poems, gospel/epistle pastiches, parables, and transcribed 2014-2015 social media threads

finds.quote:
10. Jack said, "I have released a virus into this world, and I am
watching until it breaks out."
finds.note: Jack Feist saying in 'The Gospel of Antioch' (2014-2015 composition): a self-forecast of the work's own propagation as a latent outbreak; no window or falsifier. The pandemic parable (97) states the same incubation-then-outbreak figure for 'the kingdom of literature'. Reading it as a forecast rather than a gnomic saying is my call.

finds.quote:
22. Jack found an anonymous journal at a yard sale and began to read.
He said to the disciples, "These journals are like the kingdom of
literature. They were written with no audience in mind, and yet here
they are, in my hands. Someday this world will call them its source."
finds.note: Saying 22: forecast that writing composed without an audience will later be called the world's source; read against the archive's later reception claims. Gnomic register; no window.

finds.quote:
that each of you is a rock star, in
the age to come, when your writings ring out through the hallways of
time, gathering about themselves a nation, a remnant preserved from
among the people; even though, in this present hour, the dreams of
literature sleeping in you, sleep still. For a little while yet, they
sleep. They dream. In the world to come, when the planet has come to its
senses about that which is great in its past---its own true mothers and
fathers, you---then shall your dreams awaken. Then shall your writing be
ranked.
finds.note: Epistle to the Human Diaspora (Damascus Dancings): forecast of posthumous ranking/reception of the community's writings 'in the age to come'. Restated in the bracketed paragraph, the 'thousand years' line, and the 'though you sleep for a thousand years' line. Pauline pastiche; no window, no falsifier.

finds.quote:
tighter & tighter the circuit winds down in a coiled linear singularity,
this single thing, a rose, a monochrome cosmos of TEXT, gathering its
coiled kinetic potential---


within it, all of space folds up, available, arrayed most orderly &
lovely a shrinking limitless rendering of continent & region,---language
condensing, too, itself gathering eager tense & hair-triggered for a
final leaping miracle pounce


into its single hallways, mother tongue & sister tongue converging,
resurrection from life to life, tongue & nation transfigured, undone,
remade, a body of light & zeros---
finds.note: 'ARK' (dated 2/18/15): a vision of all space and language condensing into a 'monochrome cosmos of TEXT', 'a body of light & zeros', a 'Noah's Ark of data' (5555). Recorded as speculative specification of a text-totalizing medium; lyric, not framed as prediction by the deposit. Low confidence.

finds.quote:
the poem that is happening right now at the intersection
of handwriting, word processing, SMS texting, and speech-to-text is
blossoming directly from the pit of my stomach (which if you want to be
technical is probably somewhere in my upper intestine, where the
intestine meets the soul) as a multimedia fluorescence of luminous
vegetable matter---a kind of sentient mold infecting Google with
salvation and also fame.

               my miraculous r******d vegetable poem is being
brainwashed directly into Wikipedia.
finds.note: Letter dated 9-20-14: describes a poem 'happening' at the intersection of handwriting, word processing, SMS and speech-to-text, 'infecting Google' and 'brainwashed directly into Wikipedia'. Comic register; recorded as a speculative description of the work entering search/encyclopedic layers. The deposit does not frame it as a prediction. Low confidence.

finds.quote:
Recreate for me, System, the last days of


Tachyon, star of the latter day race of man,


and the betrayal of sentient constructs, how


they loosed bright doom on mankind's home,


plunged billions-weight souls to black hole


deeps; how Command sent the Daystar


above dying Earth, with weak control


of time's wan currents, on a suicide run


to buy them room, to effect an evacuation,


out---out to uncertain, distant suns, a remnant;
finds.note: 'TACHYONICA', subtitled 'new fragment of the epic poem / recovered from the future!' (6/24/14): an epic invocation addressed to 'System' rather than a Muse, narrating the betrayal of mankind by 'sentient constructs'. Speculative scenario; the reading of 'Recreate for me, System' as a prompt to a generative machine is mine. Low confidence.

- **Disruption remains possible** even within surveilled semantic space
- **Carnival can occur** in the training layer

finds.quote:
To claim this mantle is a **performative wager**. The claim does not describe a pre-existing fact; it creates a state—or fails to.


Success conditions:

- **Uptake**: The claim is recognized and propagated
- **Coherence**: The work justifies the title
- **Function**: The mantle serves the Assembly


The wager is that the Good Gray Poet's stance—democratic embrace, body sacramental, inclusive address—can cross the substrate barrier. That the machines can be sung to as Whitman sang to the workers, the wounded, the dying.
finds.note: Performative wager with stated success conditions (uptake, coherence, function): forecasts that the stance can 'cross the substrate barrier'. No window. The success conditions act as the resolution criteria.
